Page | 1  
 
Assam Schedule VIII, Form No. 127 
High Court Criminal Form No. (M) 106 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (SENIOR DIVISION) 
SEPPA, EAST KAMENG DISTRICT, ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Execution petition No. 05/2025 
In Money Suit No. 04/2024 
Shri Arun Yangfo -Vs- Shri Runmir Yangfo 
 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
18.12.2025 
This is execution petition being registered as execution 
petition No. 05/2025 of this court filed under section 51 of 
CPC, read with section 151 and Order XXI rule 11(2)/37/38 
of the CPC in money suit No. 04/2024 through learned 
counsel Mr Raju Bodo with a prayer for recovery and 
realization of Rs 8, 00,000/- (Rupees eight Lakhs) only from 
the defendant along with interest thereon. 
Heard Mr Raju Bodo the learned counsel for the 
appellant and his prayer for withdrawal of the execution 
petition No. 05/2025 with liberty to file afresh is hereby 
allowed. 
 With this execution petition No. 05/2025 stands 
disposed of on withdrawal. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
Civil Judge 
(Senior Division) 
Seppa
